title: New West Elite
headlineSoft: redesigning New Westminster’s first AAU basketball program.
metaDescription: New Westminster's first-ever AAU basketball program designed to make basketball more accessible to the community.
storyBrief: New West Elite is a client from my hometown, New Westminster, BC. They created the city’s first competitive basketball teams for boys and girls of all ages, travelling to high-level tournaments and helping players commit to playing basketball in university. The old brand just didn’t match that.
storyConcept: The logo was far too busy, and too many shades of the brand colours made it nearly impossible to print on a jersey, use on social media, or get kids excited to wear. Now I regularly see this mark on shirts, backpacks, and shorts in my local gym. It reflects the modern, elite direction the program was heading in, and it’s a mark kids are actually proud to wear.
